name: OpenClaw Research
description: Multi-agent automated research plugin: from idea discovery to paper submission. Supports graph-grounded ideation, remote experiment execution, and evidence-backed paper writing.
author: OpenClaw Research Team

allowWorkspaceFallback.description: Allow research memory writes to fall back to workspace-level memory when OPENCLAW_PROJECT is unset.

requireProjectIsolation.description: Require OPENCLAW_PROJECT for research memory writes.

requireProjectIdInEntries.description: Require each structured memory entry to resolve to a project id.

requireTrackId.description: Require track ids for idea and experiment memory writes.

requireEvidencePointers.description: Require evidence pointers when writing structured research memory.

reviewStateMaxAgeHours.description: Maximum age of REVIEW_STATE.json before review resumability suggests a restart.

projectsRoot.description: Root directory for all research projects. Supports ~ for home directory.

servers.description: GPU server configuration for remote experiment execution

default.description: Default server name for experiment submission

list.description: Available GPU server names. Must include the default server.

divergeSize.description: Number of initial ideas to generate in diverge phase

portfolioSize.description: Number of ideas to select for tournament portfolio

tournamentRounds.description: Number of elimination rounds in idea tournament

trackPortfolio.description: Research track portfolio constraints and policies

maxActiveTracks.description: Maximum number of simultaneously active research tracks

maxParkedTracks.description: Maximum number of parked (suspended) research tracks

parkedBudgetPolicy.description: GPU budget policy for parked tracks: zero=no budget, reduced=50%, full=100%

computeBudget.description: GPU compute budget and experiment execution constraints

defaultGpuHoursPerTrack.description: Default GPU hours allocated to each research track

maxConcurrentExperiments.description: Maximum concurrent experiments per active track

gpuType.description: Default GPU type for experiments. 'mixed' allows automatic selection.

reviewLoop.description: Review loop configuration for paper drafts

maxRounds.description: Maximum review-revise rounds before requiring manual intervention

scoreThreshold.description: Minimum quality score required to advance to next stage (0-10 scale)

autoAdvanceScore.description: Score threshold for automatic advancement without review (0-10 scale)

graphConfig.description: Literature graph construction and maintenance configuration

autoRefreshTrigger.description: When to automatically refresh literature graph

noveltyThreshold.description: Minimum novelty score (0-1) for ideas in graph (lower=stricter)

maxPapersToIngest.description: Maximum papers to ingest during graph refresh
